name: dev-bother-me-nope
description: Eight-step build pipeline: one long story in, then 1 create the sprint (any UI is designed first in Claude Design and Jonathan picks one direction), 2 plan each story, 3 code with TDD using the right python skill set and merge to dev, 4 test (full suite plus headless Playwright) with one code review beside it, 5 fix every test failure and review finding, each reproduced as a failing test first, 6 test again (whatever still fails is reported, never fixed), 7 report and alert, 8 Jonathan decides: release? Yes runs the whole release in order: preflight, Supabase MAIN migrations already applied to dev, the version bump and changelog, dev merged into main and tagged, dev fast-forwarded so dev and main are the same commit, the Vercel production deploy, the GitHub release and a smoke check. No ends the run, and Jonathan decides what's next. The design pick and the release decision are the only questions. Agents gate on lint, types and related tests; the full suite and the build run only in the test steps. Until the release it never deploys to Vercel (not even dev), merges to dev never build, and migrations go to the Supabase DEV database only; a deploy-guard hook enforces this while a run is active. Merges are merge commits only, never squash: every merged branch is deleted with every worktree that has it checked out, locally and on origin, and every PR merge deletes its source branch.
